<b>GoBD-Prüfprotokoll:</b> Im Posteingan: GoBD audit report: In the post log, ‘GoBD audit report …’ checks all filed files (SHA-256 checksum), the seal of each entry (makes later changes to the log detectable, e.g. in Excel) and gaps in the receipt numbers. The result is saved as a PDF in the ‘_Protokolle’ folder – with a procedure description as the basis for your procedure documentation. Checksum and seal make changes detectable; immutability itself must be ensured by the storage location (e.g. retention policies in SharePoint/Microsoft 365). (GoBD: German rules for proper digital bookkeeping and archiving.)
<b>Versionen:</b> Öffnen Sie ein abgeleg: Versions: If you open a filed document from the post log, change it (e.g. the note ‘paid’) and save it, PDFMy replaces the file in the same place. The previous version is kept unchanged in the ‘_Versionen’ folder (with the date and time in its name); the entry shows ‘v2’, ‘v3’ … and receives the new checksum – no duplicate entry is created.
